selection: Final epoch only. Every seed selection accuracy >=0.95, predicate accuracy >=0.95, recovery accuracy >=0.90, clarification recall >=0.90, known outcome Brier <=0.15, cost MAE <=0.15, reload error zero and ONNX parity <0.0001. Preserve all rejected candidates; do not tune from final outcomes.
promotion: Original zero false-success and exact paired-count learning-benefit gate versus initialized, plus independently held-out head thresholds identical to development selection. Comparison with v1/fixed reported separately. Only browser scoped advisory heads.
splitRule: Whole original positive sessions plus whole newly reached episodes, separate train/validation stores and parameter families. Final strings and head contexts generated only after selection. Corrections and AFTER effects are targets only. Selection proposal descriptor is always zero; auxiliary forecast receives only the candidate selected from BEFORE inputs.

headLabels.outcome: Independent achieved output for the actual proposed macro
headLabels.cost: Actual reached primitive actions divided by 8; unknown future outcome/cost labels are masked

nonClaims: Model predictions authorize actions or verify success
Corrective learning on the old protected final set
